svg.title: CKA lab architecture
svg.desc: A Proxmox host running a jump host on the home LAN and an isolated network with three stacked control-plane nodes, two workers and an NFS server, plus the cluster add-ons installed in the labs.
svg.text: CKA Lab: highly available Kubernetes v1.35 on Proxmox
kubeadm · 3 stacked control planes · 2 workers · isolated lab network · auto-graded labs
local-lvm thin pool · cloud-init · per-VM snapshots
only the jump host is attached
lab snapshot / lab reset, lab VMs only
no uplink: everything leaves through jump
etcd raft cluster · 3 members · quorum 2 · survives the loss of any one control plane
k8s-api.cka.lab:6443 · TLS passthrough · health check GET /readyz
Cluster add-ons you install during the labs
cluster domain cka.local · pods 172.16.0.0/16 · services 10.112.0.0/16 · v1.34.12 → v1.35.9 (lab 07)
Icons: Kubernetes community (Apache-2.0), CNCF artwork, Simple Icons (CC0)
